intervention_description: Integrated resilience programming including food assistance for assets (FFA), lean season support (LSS), school feeding, nutrition/health support, and Smallholder Agricultural Market Support (SAMS)

intervention_start.literal_text: FFA implementation started in March 2021 in 35 percent of villages

final_followup.literal_text: Impacts measured up to two years after programme implementation, between 2021 and 2023

graduation_components_rationale.consumption_support: Cash transfers through FFA and LSS to meet immediate food needs
graduation_components_rationale.healthcare: Nutrition and health support including supplements and awareness campaigns
graduation_components_rationale.assets: Community asset creation through FFA activities
graduation_components_rationale.skills_training: Training on agricultural techniques and community asset management
graduation_components_rationale.social_empowerment: Community participation in asset selection and creation

outcomes.outcome_description: Composite score measuring dietary diversity and food consumption frequency

outcome_timing_anchor.literal_text: Impacts measured up to two years after programme implementation

outcomes.outcome_description: Scale measuring household food insecurity experiences
outcomes.literal_text: FIES indicator improves by 0.24 points (13.1% relative increase)

outcome_timing_anchor.literal_text: Impacts measured up to two years after programme implementation

outcomes.outcome_description: Total crop quantity harvested in kg
outcomes.literal_text: Overall quantity of crops harvested increased by 60 kg (total average of 309 kg) in WFP programme villages, from an average of 249 kg in the comparison group (a 22 percent increase)

outcome_timing_anchor.literal_text: Impacts measured up to two years after programme implementation

outcomes.outcome_description: Percentage of households that own livestock
outcomes.literal_text: Share of households that own livestock increased by 9 percentage points

outcome_timing_anchor.literal_text: Impacts measured up to two years after programme implementation

outcomes.literal_text: Subjective life satisfaction improved from 3.8 in comparison group to 4.05 in programme villages

outcome_timing_anchor.literal_text: Impacts measured up to two years after programme implementation

outcomes.outcome_description: Percentage of households with wage employment
outcomes.literal_text: Percentage of households with wage employment increased by 10 percentage points
